queuePolicy: READ and atomically pick one READY task using newest file blob SHA; PICKED differs from COMPLETED. A worker starts a PICKED task (IN_PROGRESS), marks source-done as COMPLETED with exact commit SHA (not verified), then independent execution evidence leads to DONE_VERIFIED. Preserve history for picked and completed, even after reassignment. One current PICKED/IN_PROGRESS task per worker. Re-fetch and retry on conflict; no silent lease stealing.

eventModel.picked: pickedBy/pickedAt plus pickHistory: reservation event. Does NOT count as implemented, complete, tested or verified.
eventModel.inProgress: IN_PROGRESS: worker has actually started implementation of picked task.
eventModel.completed: COMPLETED plus completedBy/completedAt/completionCommitSha: source work was finished and committed, but tests/independent acceptance may still be missing. Does NOT clear phase gate.
eventModel.verified: DONE_VERIFIED plus verifiedAt/verifiedBy/executed verificationEvidence: rigorous acceptance; only this closes an active required task for phase advancement.
eventModel.blocked: BLOCKED: task temporarily cannot proceed; preserve picked/completion history and next unblock condition. Can later return to READY by evidence-backed explicit change.
eventModel.reassignment: Do not erase pickHistory/completion fields. Historical picked counts report unique task IDs per worker, NOT how many are currently active. Any review/failure re-open preserves events.
